programme.title: Pooveli
programme.desc: The views and opinions of four people on love and romance change as time passes by, while they struggle to hold on to their theories in the end.

programme.title: Kalki
programme.desc: Chellammaa, a singer by profession, gets married to a businessman. However, when he learns she cannot conceive, he insults and humiliates her, which further leads to their divorce.

programme.title: Billa 2
programme.desc: David Billa works for Abbasi, a famous mobster in Goa. Due to a difference of opinion, Abbasi turns against David, and eventually gets killed by him. David must handle the situation carefully.

programme.title: Anwar
programme.desc: Anwar, a middle-class Muslim, falls in love with Mehru, a Hindu girl. Post her death, he is caught by the police and a misunderstanding leads them to believe that he is a terrorist.

programme.title: Eesa
programme.desc: When salt pan worker Eesa's wife, Selvi, is killed by Thanga Malai Annachi and his gang, Eesa decides to take revenge and starts eliminating the murderers one by one.

programme.title: Sakthi
programme.desc: After Sakthi foils Sethupati's attempt to steal the temple idols and jewels, he begins to guard the temple himself. Later, he learns that Sita, a woman ostracised by the village, is his mother.

programme.title: Chinnavar
programme.desc: Muthu and Veerasamy are best friends and fishermen, and Veerasamy's sister Meena loves Muthu. When a rich man asks Veerasamy's permission to marry Meena, she claims to have already married Muthu.

programme.title: Sigappu Rojakkal
programme.desc: Finding it hard to put his dark past behind him, Samar grows to despise girls and indulges in women trafficking. Arrested and put in an asylum by the police, he falls for a demented lady prisoner.

programme.title: Azhagi

programme.title: Engal Aasan

programme.title: Vellai Yaanai

programme.title: Pudhu Kudithanam

programme.title: January One
programme.desc: When a series of mysterious murders rock the city, a courageous inspector, Mano, sets out to capture the culprit and restore order.

programme.title: Pagal Nilavu
